Built Different

Your Patients. Your Data.
Your Partner.

You own the patient relationship

  • You own all patient communication: we transmit directly, or queue outreach for you to send — email, text, app, phone
  • Full visibility in your environment: cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, Databricks), including analytics and insights
  • Secondary consent and communication throttle — your compliance rules, enforced
  • Built-in cross-selling: introduce your other product lines through patient relationships you already own — one trusted connection, more revenue per patient

An ecosystem, not a walled garden

  • Most incumbents consume every profitable adjacent area and take control of the patient relationship — we're built not to do that
  • Other companies integrate their solutions with our core mission
  • Partners get a platform to win on — and promoting them promotes us
  • Modern, open APIs make integrations straightforward — no proprietary lock-in
We're built to give you control, not take it — your patients, your data, and your vendor relationships stay yours.
